info.title: v2.logistics.get_shipping_document_data_info
info.description: Use this api to fetch the logistics information of an order, these info can be used for self-design AWB printing. Besides, this api supports returning personal info as images.

post.description: Use this api to fetch the logistics information of an order, these info can be used for self-design AWB printing. Besides, this api supports returning personal info as images.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: h_align
parameters.description: text horizontal align, supports left, center and right.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: fields to query in the recipient address, should be name, phone, full_address, town, district, city, state, region, zipcode.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: package_number
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You shouldn't fill the field with empty string when there isn't a package number.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: recipient_address_info
parameters.description: recipient address to query as image

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/get_shipping_document_data_info?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "order_sn": "201224EM1FMFG1",
    "package_number": "9087129345",
    "recipient_address_info": [
        {
            "key": "name",
            "style": {
                "font_size": 12,
                "h_align": "center",
                "image_width": 3,
                "text_color": "#39c5bb",
                "text_style": [
                    "bold",
                    "italic"
                ]
            }
        }
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
